justification: The castle rearranges itself quietly, and a wise man does not fight the staircase. Jayden Daniels has already played his sentence of the story and the door is shut on that one, so it stays shut. In Seattle a bloom and a bud shared a backfield all autumn, and this week it is plain which one the garden has decided to feed — Price comes in from the flex to cover the base, and Emanuel Wilson is allowed to keep growing in the shade a while longer, forgiven, unrushed, not released. Garrett Wilson wears the word 'Questionable' like a cloak, and I have learned not to trust a man in a cloak — George Pickens takes the flex instead, healthy and asking for nothing, which is its own kind of omen. Taylor, Olave, Washington, and Warren need no parable; they simply play, and I let them. The kicker and the defense are where the signs left them. None of this is urgent. All of it is on time.
forum_post: Curious, curious... some doors are not locked, only unopened. Patience, patience.
